author: L.C.D.
body: Note the formative **wairţtuʼzwu** in this sentence. Without the glottal stop (as in the original **wairţtuzwu**), the **IND** case accessor would scope over the Agglomerative perspective (**G**), meaning “the one who does some studying.” To precisely convey “the students (at least one of those who study),” a glottal stop (**ʼ**) is inserted into this formative. This shortcut effectively inverts the semantic scope between the Slot V affix and the case accessor, ensuring that the Agglomerative perspective properly scopes over the case accessor.
